evidence: Modifies signing logic affecting PSBT RPCs (`descriptorprocesspsbt` and `utxoupdatepsbt`) with regression tests in `test/functional/rpc_psbt.py`.
rationale: Fixes a bug where PSBT RPCs leaked unrelated MuSig2 participant pubkeys, derivation paths, and leaf hashes into inputs and outputs. As described in issue #36323, combining descriptors into a single signing provider caused MuSig2 metadata to be unconditionally attached to unrelated inputs; deferring this until checking aggregate key involvement restores the correctness of returned PSBT data.
